anna_pm: Quick sync: packaging/pricing change rollout — need single owner per dependency (metering, billing, quota enforcement, contracts). Reply with owner + blocker. Target: feature freeze Tue EOD, rollout Wed. @mike_engineer @jess_billing @deepa_contracts @sam_platform

mike_engineer: I'll own metering adapter work. PR #482 pending review from eng-platform. Blocker: platform team needs schema change merged (will paste diff in PR).

sam_platform: Ack, will review PR today. Need clarification: schema change affects realtime metrics. Can we batch migration or do a rolling migrate? ping @jess_billing on cost signals.

jess_billing: I'll own billing mapping. Need metering adapter stable before final ratecard change. Blocker: need final quota tiers from contracts to map tiers -> prices. ETA Wed morning.

deepa_contracts: I'll own contracts constraints + quota tiers. Compiling new contract language, will post matrix by tomorrow noon. One question: do we allow grandfathering for existing enterprise customers? cc legal.

mike_engineer: For visibility, here's the local migration command we run: ```scripts/run-metering-migrate --dry-run``` -- planning dry runs on Tue. Also leaving notes in PR about toggles.

ci-bot: Build 482 started by mike_engineer, tests queued.

sam_platform: Quick note — quota enforcement requires rate-limiter changes. I'll open infra ticket and link here (INFRA-1298). No blocker on infra side, just coordination on rollout window.

anna_pm: Summary: owners set -> metering: mike; billing: jess; contracts: deepa; infra/rate-limit: sam. Action items: mike run dry-run Tue, jess wait for metering stable before ratecard flip, deepa publish tiers Tue noon, sam open infra ticket and coordinate rollout window. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
